text: However, in the case of a momentary object, its form or rasa, etc., which is then obstructed, is not experienced by the mind or the intellect; therefore, it is necessary that it be experienced through the apprehension of the meaning. And since that is its perception, the view that the form, etc., of that object is direct perception is untenable. This is because the recollection of the experienced meaning occurs. Therefore.
